IF 70853A010001, REFER TO 746A0000-06: IF MOD 30626 IS EMBODIED: TAPRV P/N 746A0000-06 AND TAPRV P/N 70853A010001 ARE TWO WAY INTERCHANGEABLE. IF MOD 30626 IS NOT EMBODIED: EITHER P/N 70853A010001 OR P/N 746A0000-06 CAN BE INSTALLED IF ZONE CONTROLLER P/N 775A0000-08 OR 775C0000-04 OR HIGHER IS INSTALLED. IF THE NEW P/N 70853A010001 IS INSTALLED THEN THE PLUG 14HK-A OF HARNESS 4609VB WILL BE REMOVED AND HARNESS WILL BE STOWED AND SECURED, OPEN ENDS WILL BE ISOLATED AS PER ESPM20-42-13 REASON: THE DUMMY CONNECTOR ON NEW TAPRV P/N 70853A010001 HAS BEEN REMOVED. (COVERED BY K32246) IF THE OLD P/N 746A0000-06 IS INSTALLED TOGETHER WITH ZONE CONTROLLER P/N 775C0000-03 AND OLDER THEN THE CONNECTOR 14HK-A MUST BE CONNECTED TO OLD TAPRV P/N 746A0000-06.
